title: Sign in with your Microsoft work account
summary: LicenseMeter now signs you in with your Microsoft work or school account only. There is no separate password or signup form, and the new sign-in page explains each step, which permissions are asked for and why. Signing in shares your name and email address and reads nothing from your tenant; connecting Microsoft 365 stays a separate, read-only admin consent. Existing members keep their workspaces: when Microsoft confirms your email address the account is linked automatically, otherwise we send a one-time confirmation link to that address. Password, multi-factor and profile settings are managed in your Microsoft account.
